# Nimbus² (v2.6.0) — Sovereign Executive Build Manager, Autonomous PR Reviewer & Polyglot Proxy Suite

> Zero-dependency Go/Rust/Python build & network execution suite engineered by Collins Takem (RASA-X-MACHINA · tianxiaOS). Operates as the Executive Build & Release Manager paired bilaterally with the `Tianxia-Core/Build-Law` engineering constitution.

## Core Capabilities (`CGO_ENABLED=0` Static Binary)
- `nimbus2 ship`: Autonomous domain-grouped Git commit, Clean-Room public isolation firewall, branch, push, PR & squash auto-merge.
- `nimbus2 review-diff`: Deterministic `$0.00` (`0` LLM token) 14-Gate differential security, prompt-injection, Unicode Bidi & Cargo `0.x` SemVer PR auditor.
- `nimbus2 cleanroom` / `nimbus2 init-clean`: Enforces `PUBLIC_CLEANROOM_SEED` vs `FOUNDER_INTERNAL` isolation and bootstraps fresh zero-PII end-user schemas.
- `nimbus2 estimate`: Calibrated FC Algebraic Build Estimator v4.2 (`95.0%` validated accuracy) + Build Law `8.8x` token/EUR budget calculator.
- `nimbus2 proxy` / `health` / `bench` / `validate` / `detect` / `multiboot` / `tui`: Bounded concurrent HTTP/HTTPS CONNECT proxy, TLS 1.3 route benchmark, SOFTEM hardware classifier & multiboot ISO verifier.
